environment.tool: manual audit of the tag source + live compiled binary; openssl s_client for SNI, strict upstream peer

findings.description: The SNI callback sets only the certificate; the route pointer is untouched, making SNI a certificate authority and never a route authority.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled

findings.description: SNI beta.test with Host alpha.test serves beta's certificate with a passing hostname verify and executes on alpha's upstream: certificate and route are chosen by different, unreconciled strings.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled

findings.description: Upstream always receives the constant Host: 127.0.0.1:<port>; the client's Host never reaches the upstream.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled

findings.description: This build is the contrast case: duplicate server_name values are rejected at config load, so the name set handed to SNI and the name set matched by Host cannot diverge through a duplicate.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled

limitations: All RCE is on the upstream host
Needs a TLS listener and two server blocks
An exec route must be proxied on the routed vhost to show command output
